scope: All 16 raw/log file hashes, frozen commands and binary; dense full decompressed controls/observations and normalized sensor evidence match archived survey-on runs and paired arms.

Prior independent physical/native/upstream/original-survey proof is reused only after exact complete traces, sensor work, physical reports and original comparison/survey ledgers match its hash-pinned inputs.

First charged event, immutable historical candidate status/tick/generation, next real tick, typed actor/vehicle/spaceling/episode snapshot, empty versus measured attachments and untriggered outcomes independently checked.

Every fresh ledger row checked for dense source/job sets, token namespace, separate world/dispatch clocks, residual64 graph arithmetic, cumulative work, phase, source expiry and continued real observation validation after original retirement.

Historical rigid geometry, both frozen solar directions and native same-ID geometry/solar signs independently reconstructed using pinned older f32 geometry/native helpers and frozen .002 geometry/.01 solar/.02 departure-tie tolerances.

Continuous actor/material/ownership identity starts at original measurement and extends to actual native choice; source-only forecast, retrospective actual choice and same-time planet residuals remain separate.

All eight observed first triggers are measured (four correlated cases duplicated across arms); negative/incomplete/refusal/reset/zero-budget/multi-actor cases have focused test coverage, not observed coverage in this corpus.

Four overlapping original sources in one quiet world. This does not establish policy improvement, general acquisition costs, near-sun safety, playing multiactor fairness or device/frame-time performance.
The audit checks archived runtime evidence, not a fresh simulation or binary reproducibility build; local suite counts are parent-reported.
checker_incident_summary: Before the successful full pass, the independent checker was corrected to allow a numerical arrival frame without attached geometry and to preserve zero-valued per-run counters. These are checker assumptions, not experiment/runtime changes; all failed checker records are retained.

validation_counts.source: Parent-reported successful local checks; this independent evidence audit does not rerun those suites or independently inspect complete saved logs.
